This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" /> [[Lazu Lirona]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TROSVD" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] skin<ref name="TROSVD" /> which possessed a scaly texture.<ref name="BTS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the [[Battle of Exegol]] one year after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[34 ABY]], therefore putting the battle in [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species, [[Lazu Lirona]], participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of [[Citizens' Fleet|the fleet]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' gathered from the [[Core Worlds]], traveling to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to join their victory celebrations afterwards.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their onscreen debut in the [[2019]] film {{Film|IX}}, directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer and sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]].<ref name="JLD">{{Twitter|username=JakeLuntDavies
|url=status/1619319638466379778|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2023-01-28|quote=Louis Wiltshire was the designer/sculptor|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/sQxwh}} {{C|In response to: "Sentient Star Wars Species that are unidentified as of this tweet Day 126: Lazu Lirona’s Species! First Appearance: “Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker” Canon: Yes Creator: Unclear Notes: Fun background design, and we know that @RealCharLouise brought the character to life!"}}</ref>
